transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I just can't seem to get anything in order anymore. My kitchen table is just... covered. It's got my husband's appointment papers, church flyers, notes from the senior center... half-finished lists. I just sit there and... I don't know what to do first. And then the whole day is just gone.
Have you had this kind of trouble staying organized and getting started on tasks since childhood?

I suppose so... yes. Even when I was a little girl, my teachers used to write notes saying I was... well, bright, but careless. I was always forgetting my books or my homework. They'd have to keep reminding me to finish my seatwork before they'd let me go outside. So... yes. It's been like this for a long time.
When you were a child, were you also unusually fidgety or unable to sit still?

I... I don't really remember much about being a little girl. But I suppose... yes. Even now, if I'm just trying to sit politely in a meeting, I... I catch myself rubbing my hands together. Or tapping my foot. Clicking my pen. I end up shifting around so much that... well, people look over at me. I just have a hard time staying completely still.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I just get a bit frustrated with myself sometimes, with the mess, but... no. I don't feel depressed.
Do you worry a lot about different things most days?
I... no, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I have the usual concerns, I suppose, but... no. I don't spend my days worrying.
Did these difficulties start after a specific stressful event or major life change?
No... not that I can think of. It's just... always been this way, I suppose.
How much are these problems interfering with your day-to-day life?

Well... it's getting in the way, I suppose. I... I had to step down from leading this big event at the senior center recently. It was just... too much. And my daughter... she's started double-checking my bills and my appointments. She, um... she just doesn't trust that I can keep everything straight on my own anymore.
Was there a specific stressful event or major change in your life shortly before these problems got worse?
No... not really. Like I said before, nothing specific comes to mind. It's just... I don't know.
Did these problems start within a few months after a specific stressful event or major life change?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. Like I said... there wasn't any big event or change. It's just always been this way.
Before you were 12 years old, do you remember having problems like this with paying attention or staying organized?

I suppose so, yes. Even... even when I was a little girl. I remember my teachers writing notes on my report cards... saying I was bright, but... careless. I was always forgetting my books, or my homework. They... they always had to remind me to finish my seatwork before they'd let me go outside. So... yes.
Did your current problems begin after a specific stressful event?
I... no. I believe I just answered that. There wasn't any event.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
No. I... haven't noticed anything like that. I still do the things I usually do.
